title: UHCMEETUP
body:
● UHCMEETUP is a Paper UHC Deathmatch plugin with two game modes.                                                                                                                                                                                 Overworld Mode
  Standard UHC played on a vanilla overworld map. Ocean and river biomes are replaced with land to keep the map walkable  and PvP-friendly. Includes extra ore veins and a tracking compass.

  Nether Mode
  UHC played entirely in the Nether. Players start with bottled water and food. Every 3 nether gold ore mined grants a
  golden apple. Overworld portal travel is blocked. Same shrinking border forces late-game fights.

  Gameplay
  - Queue-based auto-start with configurable player count and countdown
  - Grace period with damage immunity at game start
  - Random T1/T2/T3 kits — armor, weapons, tools, diamonds, and golden apples
  - Golden heads drop on kill — right-click to eat, grants Regen III + Absorption I, 10s cooldown
  - Kill streaks with tiered announcements and chat kill-count prefix
  - Sidebar scoreboard with alive count, timer, and personal kills
  - Enemy-tracking compass on cooldown
  - World border shrinks from 600 to 32 blocks over 20 minutes
  - Leaves drop apples, piglins drop heads, mobs drop boosted loot

  Requirements
  Paper 1.21.4+, Java 21
